                         B_ENT.EXPN, B_ENT.EXP, ACT.AC_NUM, B_ENT.BD_NUM
FROM            B_ENT, ACT
WHERE        B_ENT.BC_NUM = ACT.AC_NUM

SELECT        B_ENT.B_ID, B_ENT.B_DATE, B_ENT.B_VD, B_ENT.BD_NUM, B_ENT.B_VC, B_ENT.BC_NUM, B_ENT.B_EXP, B_ENT.SH_CH, B_ENT.CH_ID, B_ENT.CH_DAT,
                         B_ENT.CH_BK, B_ENT.EXPN, B_ENT.EXP, ACT.AC_NAM

SELECT        C_ENT.CH_ID, C_ENT.CH_DAT, C_ENT.CH_BK, C_ENT.EXPN, C_ENT.EXP, C_ENT.C_EXP, C_ENT.C_VC, C_ENT.CD_NUM, C_ENT.C_VD, C_ENT.C_DATE, C_ENT.C_ID,
                          C_ENT.SH_CH, ACT.AC_NAM, C_ENT.CC_NUM
FROM            ACT, C_ENT

from  v_t_d , v_t_c , vtd , vtc
where  v_t_d.snum = v_t_c.snum  and  v_t_d.snum = vtd.snum(+)  and  v_t_d.snum = vtc.snum(+)
order by v_t_d.snum

from  v_t_d , v_t_c , vtd , vtc
where  v_t_d.num = v_t_c.num  and  v_t_d.num = vtd.num(+)  and  v_t_d.num = vtc.num(+)
and  ( nvl(vtd.b_d,0) - nvl(vtc.b_c,0) ) <> 0
order by v_t_d.num
